scope: TypePHP 0.9.2 PCNTL output parameter code generation

hostComparison.privateBuildPhpWithoutPcntl: generated php::VarList{status, ...}; output parameter passed by value

rootCause: TypePHP asks the build-host PHP Reflection API whether a runtime function parameter is by-reference. When the host lacks PCNTL, Reflection has no signature for the Linux target's pcntl_wait function.

boundedPatch.behavior: Fallback reference metadata is used only when the build host cannot reflect the function; existing reflection remains authoritative when present.
boundedPatch.patchedDryRun: generated php::RefWrap<php::Int> and commit() under a host PHP without PCNTL
boundedPatch.referenceMatrixDryRun: positional references emitted and committed for pcntl_wait, pcntl_waitpid, pcntl_waitid, pcntl_sigprocmask; named pcntl_wait status emitted as a reference
